state.misconception_label: Does not know units of area should be squared

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I have: James has answered a question on the area of a trapezium and got an answer of \( 54 \). Behind the star he has written the units that he used. \( 54 \, \bigstar \) Which of the following units could be correct? I got \( m \) because I added the side lengths instead of multiplying.

turn_history.text:

  2. Topic: Perform calculations with areas when given in different units. Correct answer (C): \( 404 \mathrm{~mm}^{2} \). Student selected: \( 8 \mathrm{~mm}^{2} \). Underlying misconception: Does not convert measurements to have the same units before calculating area or volume. Intervention focus: surface why the selected answer is wrong and walk through the reasoning that leads to the correct answer.
  3. Topic: Calculate the area of a right-angled triangle where the dimensions are given in the same units. Correct answer (D): \( 44 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \). Student selected: \( 88 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \). Underlying misconception: Does not divide by 2 when calculating the area of a triangle. Intervention focus: surface why the selected answer is wrong and walk through the reasoning that leads to the correct answer.
